{
  "candidate_rtl": "module decoder_8bit
 #(
    parameter N = 8
) (
    input [N-1:0] in,
    output reg [(1<<N)-1:0] out
);
    wire [3:0] low_pair0;
    wire [3:0] low_pair1;
    wire [3:0] high_pair0;
    wire [3:0] high_pair1;
    wire [15:0] low_dec;
    wire [15:0] high_dec;
    wire [255:0] decoded;

    genvar p;
    generate
        for (p = 0; p < 4; p = p + 1) begin : gen_pair_decode
            assign low_pair0[p]  = (p & 1) ? in[0] : ~in[0];
            assign low_pair1[p]  = (p & 1) ? in[2] : ~in[2];
            assign high_pair0[p] = (p & 1) ? in[4] : ~in[4];
            assign high_pair1[p] = (p & 1) ? in[6] : ~in[6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar q;
    generate
        for (q = 0; q < 16; q = q + 1) begin : gen_nibble_decode
            assign low_dec[q]  = low_pair0[q % 4] & low_pair1[q / 4];
            assign high_dec[q] = high_pair0[q % 4] & high_pair1[q / 4];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 256; k = k + 1) begin : gen_decode
            assign decoded[k] = low_dec[k % 16] & high_dec[k / 16];
        end
    endgenerate

    always @(*) begin
        out = decoded;
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The output decode plane contains 256 final product terms, with the critical path passing through the two-level nibble decoders and one final combining AND.",
  "rewrite": "Replace variable-width shift inference with explicit factored 2-bit, 4-bit, and 8-bit one-hot expansion. Shared pair terms reduce repeated input-literal logic while keeping the final decode fan-in at two inputs.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicit balanced structure should reduce variable-shift mux depth to approximately three logic levels from an input literal to an output, improving maximum data arrival while maintaining direct combinational outputs.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds a small amount of intermediate wiring and pair-decoder logic, but shares common terms across outputs. The resulting gate count is expected to remain below the stated area cap and should reduce routing and fan-in pressure.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For N=8 and all 256 binary input values, exactly one output bit is asserted at index in and all other output bits are cleared. The parameter declaration, module name, port widths, output reg type, and combinational behavior are preserved."
}
